title: DECISION: imap4rev2_enabled is a one-way latch, never reset to false
description: RFC 9051 §6.3.2 requires that once a client enables IMAP4rev2 semantics for a session, that activation is permanent for the lifetime of the session. The SessionContext field imap4rev2_enabled is initialised to false and handle_enable() sets it to true but never sets it back. The comment 'Set to true by the ENABLE handler; never reset to false' is the machine-checkable contract. Alternative rejected: making the field a toggle (true/false per ENABLE command) would violate RFC 9051 §6.3.2 and could cause clients that probe with ENABLE to see inconsistent behaviour if they somehow sent a second ENABLE with a different set of capabilities.
